steps.en: OCMS gets defendants' mobile numbers from DOS
steps.id: OCMS mengambil nomor mobile defendant dari DOS
steps.why_en: No link to DOS exists, and DOS itself cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada sambungan ke DOS, dan DOS sendiri tidak bisa dipastikan.

steps.en: Pick each unique defendant once per batch
steps.id: Pilih tiap defendant unik sekali per batch
steps.why_en: Nothing selects defendants with warrant notices.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang memilih defendant dengan warrant notice.

steps.en: Write an SMS with warrant notice details
steps.id: Tulis SMS berisi detail warrant notice
steps.why_en: No warrant message text or fields exist.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada teks atau field pesan warrant.

steps.en: Send the reminder SMS to defendants
steps.why_en: Only a general SMS sender for other notices exists, and it is switched off in production config.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada pengirim SMS umum untuk notice lain, dan mati di konfigurasi production.
